ignis.login.title: Sign in
ignis.login.heading: Admin panel
ignis.login.2fa_prompt: Account {login} has two-step sign-in enabled. Enter the six-digit code from the app.
ignis.account.must_change_why: Someone else set this password, so at least one other person knows it. Until you change it, the other pages stay closed.
ignis.account.totp_add: Add this account in your app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password), then type in the code it shows.
ignis.account.totp_saved_after: The secret is saved only after a correct code, so a typo will not lock you out.
ignis.account.totp_why: With a second factor, a stolen password alone is not enough to get into the panel.
ignis.account.totp_lost: Lost your phone? An administrator can disable it in the permissions panel — with a trace in the audit log.
ignis.account.change_closes: Changing it closes all sessions of this account, including this one — you will sign in with the new password.
ignis.account.totp_recommended: This is a platform account — it sees all customers' data. A password alone is not enough.
ignis.account.logout_all_why: Useful if you signed in on someone else's computer or lost your phone.
ignis.account.totp_on_info: When you sign in, the panel asks for a six-digit code from your app.
ignis.account.logout_all_confirm: Close all sessions of this account? You will be logged out.
ignis.account.must_enable_totp: Enable two-step sign-in (TOTP) to use the panel.
ignis.account.must_enable_totp_why: This account requires a second factor. Until you enable it, the other pages stay closed.
ignis.account.totp_required_info: This account requires a second factor — it cannot disable it itself. If you lose the phone, an administrator can help.
ignis.account.must_change: Change your password to use the panel.
ignis.account.totp_open: open in an app on this device
ignis.account.totp_card_sub: code from an app, second factor
ignis.account.title: My account
ignis.audit_log.immutable: An entry is written for every panel action and cannot be changed or deleted here. Passwords, tokens and certificates never reach the details — "(hidden)" appears in their place.
ignis.audit_log.empty: No entries yet. The audit log fills itself with every change made in the panel.
ignis.dashboard.who_can_sub: effective permissions after expanding patterns and subtracting denials
ignis.audit_log.title: Audit log
ignis.dashboard.title: Dashboard
ignis.audit_log.support_note: Entries marked {support} are operations performed in your account by the platform team.
ignis.files.drop: Drag files here or click to choose
ignis.files.title: Files
ignis.files.name: Name
ignis.files.drop_target: They go to {folder}. You can upload several at once.
ignis.files.delete_confirm: Delete {name}? The file cannot be recovered.
ignis.files.view_only: You can view files. Uploading and changes need separate permissions from the {section} section.
ignis.permissions.own_note: Your own permissions are changed by another administrator; password and 2FA — in "My account".
ignis.permissions.pattern_future: A pattern also covers permissions added in the future.
ignis.permissions.deny_wins_sub: — it takes away even what a package grants
ignis.permissions.title: Permissions
ignis.permissions.name: Name
ignis.permissions.delete_package_confirm: Delete package {name}? It also disappears from the accounts that have it.
ignis.permissions.disable_totp_confirm: Disable two-step sign-in for {login}? The account will be protected by the password alone until they enable it again.
ignis.permissions.delete_account_confirm: Delete account {login}? This cannot be undone.
ignis.permissions.read_only: Read-only view without the right to change ({permission}).
ignis.permissions.catalog_help: The dictionary of everything that can be granted. It is filled from code when a node starts ({file}) — a new permission is added there, not in the database.
ignis.settings.delete_creds_confirm: Delete the saved credentials? Features that use them will stop working.
ignis.settings.creds_saved: Credentials are saved — uploading a new file will replace them.
ignis.settings.drop: Drag a file here or click to choose
ignis.settings.title: Configuration
ignis.settings.read_only: You can view the configuration but not change it (missing {permission}) — the fields are disabled.
ignis.msg.login.too_many: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
ignis.msg.login.no_access: This account has no access to any section. Ask an administrator to grant a permission package.
ignis.msg.login.too_many_codes: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
ignis.msg.login.account_locked: Too many wrong codes for this account. Try again in an hour.
ignis.msg.login.wrong_code: The code does not match. Check the app and enter the current one.
ignis.msg.account.password_changed: Password changed. Sign in with the new one — other sessions have been closed.
ignis.msg.account.wrong_code: The code does not match. Check that the app shows the current one.
ignis.msg.account.totp_enabled: Two-step sign-in enabled. Other sessions closed; from the next sign-in the panel will ask for a code.
ignis.msg.account.totp_already: Two-step sign-in is already enabled. To switch apps, disable it (with your password) and enable it again.
ignis.msg.account.totp_required: The second factor is mandatory on this account. Only an administrator can disable it.
ignis.msg.account.totp_disabled: Two-step sign-in disabled. The account is now protected by the password alone.
ignis.msg.account.sessions_closed: All sessions of this account have been closed. Sign in again.
ignis.msg.password.too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
ignis.msg.password.too_long: The password can be at most 72 bytes (about 72 characters; accented letters count double).
ignis.msg.password.repeat_mismatch: The repeated password does not match.
ignis.msg.password.same_as_old: The new password must differ from the current one.
ignis.msg.password.old_mismatch: The current password does not match.
ignis.msg.storage.folder_exists: A folder with this name already exists here.
ignis.msg.storage.folder_not_empty: The folder is not empty ({files} files, {folders} subfolders).
ignis.msg.storage.quota: Out of space: the service has a {limit} MB limit.
ignis.msg.files.uploaded_dupes: Uploaded {n}, skipped {dupes} (the same file is already here).
ignis.msg.files.delete_failed: Could not delete the file from storage — try again.
ignis.msg.permissions.package_name_empty: The package name cannot be empty.
ignis.msg.permissions.only_own: You can only grant permissions you have yourself.
ignis.msg.permissions.would_lose_edit: This change would take "permissions.edit" away from you — you could not undo it.
ignis.msg.permissions.delete_would_lose_: Deleting it would take "permissions.edit" away from you — you could not undo it.
ignis.msg.permissions.package_deleted: Package deleted (also removed from the accounts that had it).
ignis.msg.permissions.too_many_accounts: Too many new accounts at once. Try again in an hour.
ignis.msg.permissions.login_unavailable: This username is unavailable — choose another one.
ignis.msg.permissions.account_created: Account "{login}" created (no packages — grant them below).
ignis.msg.permissions.not_own: You cannot change your own permissions — ask another administrator. Change your password in "My account".
ignis.msg.permissions.saved_password_not: Permissions saved, but the password was NOT — {reason}
ignis.msg.permissions.own_totp: Disable your own two-step sign-in in "My account" (with your password).
ignis.msg.permissions.totp_removed: Account "{login}" now signs in with the password alone. Ask its owner to enable two-step sign-in again in "My account".
ignis.msg.permissions.not_own_delete: You cannot delete your own account.
ignis.msg.permissions.last_editor: This is the last account with "permissions.edit" — deleting it would lock the panel for good.
ignis.msg.permissions.system_package: Package "{name}" is not changed in the panel — it is the last guarantee of access.
ignis.msg.permissions.package_above: The package grants permissions you do not have — you cannot change or delete it.
ignis.msg.permissions.holders_above: Accounts with permissions you do not have hold this package — you cannot change or delete it.
ignis.msg.permissions.account_above: This account has permissions you do not have — you cannot change or delete it.

ignis.msg.settings.not_yours: This section does not belong to your site.
ignis.msg.settings.creds_too_big: A credentials file should not be larger than 64 KB — this is surely not the right file.
